title: Where Do LLMs Learn to Recommend AI?
abstract: arXiv:2610.29785v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Asked what to study, which career to pursue, or what product to build, large language models (LLMs) often recommend AI-related options. We ask where this tendency comes from by comparing models before and after fine-tuning and by varying how questions are asked. First, pretrained models already include explicit AI/ML terms in the recommendations of 27% of their responses, and their released instruction-tuned versions do so in 59%. Second, fine-tuning models ourselves shows that this rise is not inevitable: general instruction tuning leaves the rate unchanged, but removing the 7% of instruction examples that concern AI cuts it by 14 percentage points, below the level of the pretrained models it starts from. Data rewarding helpfulness raise it by 9 points, while data ranked by the preferences of diverse simulated users lower it by 9. Finally, with models held fixed, asking for the "best" option or for what to do "right now" raises the rate

translated_title: 大语言模型从哪里学会推荐AI？
translated_abstract: 当被问及该学什么专业、从事什么职业或开发什么产品时，大语言模型（LLM）经常会推荐与AI相关的选项。我们通过比较微调前后的模型以及改变提问方式，来探究这种倾向的来源。首先，预训练模型在其27%的回复推荐中已包含明确的AI/ML术语，而其发布的指令微调版本中这一比例达到59%。其次，我们自己进行微调的实验表明，这种上升并非不可避免：一般的指令微调不会改变该比例，但剔除指令数据中涉及AI的7%样本后，该比例会下降14个百分点，甚至低于其起始的预训练模型水平。奖励“有帮助性”的数据会使该比例上升9个百分点，而根据多样化模拟用户偏好排序的数据则会使其下降9个百分点。最后，在模型保持不变的情况下，要求给出“最佳”选项或询问“现在”该做什么，也会提高这一比例。
tldr: 研究发现LLM过度推荐AI的倾向主要源于指令微调数据中约7%的AI相关样本——剔除这些数据可将推荐率降至预训练模型水平以下，而追求“有帮助”的数据和“最佳”“立刻”式的提问方式则会进一步推高该倾向。
en_tdlr: LLMs' tendency to recommend AI stems mainly from the ~7% AI-related examples in instruction-tuning data—removing them cuts recommendation rates below pretrained levels—while helpfulness-rewarding data and "best"/"right now" prompts further amplify it.
